items.title: Ukrainian LLM Leaderboard
items.claim: The project documents Ukrainian model benchmarks across translation, summarisation, question answering, reasoning, mathematics, instruction following, and fairness; it does not present a general end-user service ranking.

items.title: Toward a Gold-Standard Benchmark for Evaluating Ukrainian Language Proficiency in LLMs
items.claim: The expert-curated Ukrainian grammar and orthography benchmark reports a maximum 59.6% accuracy among evaluated large-scale LLMs under its study settings.

items.title: Copilot in Excel FAQ
items.claim: Microsoft lists Ukrainian for Copilot in Excel prompts and cautions that non-English prompts or data may perform less well; it also warns that AI output can be inaccurate or misinterpret information.

items.title: Cloud Speech-to-Text V1 supported languages
items.claim: Google documents Ukrainian (uk-UA) and its available V1 recognition models and features. This is a support statement, not an accuracy comparison.

items.title: MAI-Transcribe-2 documentation
items.claim: Microsoft documents Ukrainian support for MAI-Transcribe-2, public-preview status without an SLA, and diarization failures on recordings of about 15 minutes or longer.
